open_points.subject: read_mark
open_points.text: read_mark: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None when _read_record gives None for _mark_path of the project id and source id, letting its DelivererError pass; otherwise it MUST return the PublicationMark those bytes hold only when they are one JSON text in the encoding the JSON standard requires, with no byte-order mark, valid against = models.PublicationMark with no extra field, whose project_id and source_id are the given ones, and MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns for any other content.
open_points.rule: Адрес, записанный без `=` — в обратных кавычках или словами, — не разыменовывается вовсе: до модели не доходит ни значение, ни символ, и она вынуждена значение сочинить. Обе формы невалидны для значения, которое читает генерируемый код.
open_points.question: The encoding requirement must name a value through one of the permitted paths, such as an imported encoding constant declared in the module's import surface, rather than referring to “the encoding the JSON standard requires” in prose.
